# v3.2.0 — Modules 1–3 Harmonization

## Shared learning design

- Applies one lesson contract across all 122 topic pages: objectives, decision logic, retained evidence, topic-appropriate visuals, applied artifacts, explicit trade-offs, complete assessment rationales, practitioner guidance, related concepts, and sequential navigation.
- Adds cross-module prerequisite and continuation routes from demand and forecasting through network design, digital connectivity, sourcing, and supplier execution.
- Adds reusable topic, section-review, capstone-assignment, and capstone-solution templates aligned with the published standard.

## Capstones, references, and calculations

- Rebuilds the AsterWorks Module 2 capstone around all nine module datasets, an end-to-end process flow, network and technology calculations, control gates, sensitivity analysis, performance baselines, and an implementation roadmap.
- Adds five decision checks and a strengthened worked solution to the NorthStar Module 1 capstone, plus a primary-source Module 1 reference register.
- Aligns all three capstone solutions around executive recommendations, decision-changing sensitivity cases, owned implementation roadmaps, and completion rubrics.
- Links quantitative Module 1 and Module 2 lessons directly to their datasets and formula sheets.

## Durable quality controls

- Extends validation across all three modules for lesson structure, process flows, assessment rationale, navigation, direct data links, capstone depth, inventory totals, orphaned assets, SVG accessibility, and independently reproduced calculations.
- Adds an idempotent Module 1 and Module 2 harmonization script and an all-module visual contact-sheet renderer.
- Verifies 159 module Markdown files, 319 knowledge checks, 1,039 internal links, 80 SVG diagrams, and 26 CSV datasets.
